research_question: Under the EXACT frozen D1 treatment (deterministic administrative phase navigation REPRODUCE->UNDERSTAND->RUNTIME_EVIDENCE after a real failure_reproduced==true observation, then the unchanged S1 RUNTIME_EVIDENCE model-facing surface), with the ONLY material model-condition change being RAW Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct -> the definitive surviving cp118 tuned checkpoint, can the cp118 model enter a real PDB interaction loop on curated-off-by-one-002?

source_baseline.note: S2 is based on the accepted D1 source commit (which in turn descends from the accepted S1 source commit). The live run binds to the committed clean HEAD (source_commit_sha) which must descend from these accepted baselines. S2 adds files under experiments/debugger_interaction_v2_s2_cp118/ only; production core, S1 files, and D1 files are unchanged.

adapter_identity.selection_rule: best surviving saved checkpoint by held-out SWE-rebench validation eval_loss only

s2_treatment.description: S2 replicates the frozen D1 treatment EXACTLY (deterministic administrative REPRODUCE->UNDERSTAND->RUNTIME_EVIDENCE after a real failure_reproduced==true observation; everything from RUNTIME_EVIDENCE onward model-authored at the unchanged S1 state-specific command surface) and changes ONLY the model condition: RAW Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct base -> the definitive surviving cp118 tuned checkpoint (PEFT/QLoRA adapter, base c03e6d358207e414f1eca0bb1891e29f1db0e242, adapter identity above).
s2_treatment.automation_trigger: real run_reproduction observation with failure_reproduced == true
s2_treatment.stop_rule: If successful reproduction does not occur, STOP; do not force runtime entry.

treatment_differences_from_d1.model_condition: RAW_BASE -> CP118_TUNED (definitive surviving cp118 PEFT/QLoRA checkpoint)
treatment_differences_from_d1.adapter_applied: false -> true (RAW base only -> cp118 PEFT adapter applied)
treatment_differences_from_d1.description: The ONLY material model-condition change relative to D1 is RAW Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct -> the definitive cp118 tuned checkpoint. The D1 harness automation (administrative phase navigation only), the S1 RUNTIME_EVIDENCE prompt/grammar, controller, state machine, ToolRegistry, PdbPolicy.ALWAYS_ON, PDB backend, verifier, task, budgets, timeouts, generation configuration, quantization, RAG OFF, and evidence/provenance architecture are reused unchanged. The D1 harness may still automate ONLY REPRODUCE->UNDERSTAND->RUNTIME_EVIDENCE after real failure_reproduced==true; it must not choose any debugger command or breakpoint.

frozen_variables.model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct @ c03e6d358207e414f1eca0bb1891e29f1db0e242 + definitive cp118 PEFT adapter
frozen_variables.tokenizer_chat_template: frozen at base revision (same as D1/v1)
frozen_variables.quantization: 4-bit NF4 with double quantization (same as D1/v1)

legacy.description: The repository's existing Gate-B computation, unchanged (experiments/debugger_interaction_v2/runner.py:_compute_gate_b). Administrative transitions inserted by the D1 harness do NOT count.
conditions: 1. Model emits a valid debugger command accepted by the controller that reaches the real PDB backend.
2. A real PDB observation is produced and bound into the next model request via prior_observation_id + rendered_observation_sha256 provenance.
3. After receiving that request, the model emits a second accepted debugger command.
4. That second command also reaches the real PDB backend and produces another real observation.

strict.description: A real iterative debugger loop. Tool-error observations may be retained as real provenance evidence but MUST NOT satisfy Gate B strict.
conditions: 2. The command reaches the real PDB backend.
3. It produces a SUCCESSFUL NON-ERROR PDB observation/state (observation status OK).
4. That exact observation is bound into the next actual model request (prior_observation_id + rendered_observation_sha256 provenance).
5. The model authors a second accepted PDB command.
6. The second command reaches the real PDB backend and also produces a successful non-error PDB observation/control result (observation status OK).

gate_c_criteria.description: Full dynamic trajectory kept separate: successful runtime evidence -> model-authored post-debug diagnosis -> patch -> verifier. Report patch apply, F2P, P2P and RESOLVED honestly.

patch_policy.description: The S1-P serialization-normalization diagnostic is NOT part of the S2 treatment. No patch normalizer is applied. If the cp118 model produces a malformed or non-applicable patch, the RAW live outcome is preserved exactly; any serialization analysis would be a separate post-hoc diagnostic, not part of this run.

after_the_single_s2_live_run: NO rerun because output is undesirable
NO repair or prompt/interface modification after seeing the result

claims_boundary: S2 is a single-run model-condition diagnostic. It is NOT a new protocol campaign, NOT an interface repair, NOT a prompt-optimization campaign, and NOT a general repair pass. A successful S2 supports only: under the frozen D1 treatment with deterministic administrative phase navigation after verified reproduction, the definitive cp118 tuned checkpoint can (or cannot) enter a real PDB interaction loop on curated-off-by-one-002. Do NOT infer broad fine-tuning conclusions from one task.
